morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中作为完整借词词根处理，不拆成马来语 im- 与 plan。音节边界为 im.plan；派生词 pengimplanan 保留词根拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 植入物；通过手术放入、植入或贴附于体内的材料、组织或装置。
senses.en_definition: Material, tissue, or a device surgically inserted into or attached within the body.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu, seperti bahan atau tisu, yang dimasukkan, ditanam atau ditempelkan ke dalam tubuh melalui pembedahan.
senses.nuances: 依据输入包所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》展开缩写整理。主要指植入的物体；操作过程称 pengimplanan。可按部位或功能细分，不宜把所有用途拆成互不相关的词义。pengimplanan 与 diimplankan 均见马来西亚官方用例。[官方用例](https://www.dbkl.gov.my/files/senarai-perundangan/subsidiari/%2816%29-uuk-pelesenan-anjing-dan-rumah-pembiakan-anjing-%28wpkl%29-1991.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak hospital telah menerima bekalan implan ortopedik untuk kegunaan dalam pembedahan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 医院已收到供手术使用的骨科植入物。
dual_scenarios.en: The hospital has received a supply of orthopedic implants for surgical use.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mak dah tanya doktor pasal implan gigi tu ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah ibu sudah bertanya kepada doktor tentang implan gigi itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 妈妈问过医生那个牙种植体的事了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has Mum asked the dentist about that dental implant yet?
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah；pasal 对应 tentang。
句末 ke 在这里构成是非问句。

messages.speaker: Aina (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Mak dah tanya doktor pasal implan gigi tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah ibu sudah bertanya kepada doktor tentang implan gigi itu?
messages.zh: 妈妈问过医生那个牙种植体的事了吗？
messages.en: Has Mum asked the dentist about that dental implant yet?

messages.speaker: Hafiz (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Mak nak bincang kos dulu sebelum buat keputusan.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Ibu mahu membincangkan kos terlebih dahulu sebelum membuat keputusan.
messages.zh: 问过了。妈妈想先谈谈费用再决定。
messages.en: Yes. She wants to discuss the cost before deciding.

etymology.historical_story: Implan belongs to international medical vocabulary represented by English implant. The English word developed from French implanter, literally associated with planting something inside. Its later surgical meaning preserves that image: something is placed within the body. Malay treats implan as a complete base and can build forms such as pengimplanan from it. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/implant)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 im.plan 时联想英语 implant 和 plant“种下”：把材料“种进”体内，就是植入物；这只是联想，不是马来语构词拆分。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的医疗术语。与患者交谈时，可先说明是哪一种 implan，避免让对方误以为专指美容或避孕用途。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合医疗咨询、新闻及费用讨论。涉及个人的牙科、美容或避孕植入物时，应尊重隐私，不在公共场合追问。
